name: Centrifugal and positive displacement pumps
principle: A centrifugal pump converts rotational kinetic energy into hydrodynamic energy of the fluid with an impeller inside a volute or diffuser casing. Positive-displacement pumps suit high pressure and are the alternative.

process_steps.name: Fluid enters at the eye of the casing
Volute or diffuser slows it and raises pressure

performance.basis: two pumps in parallel for a 350 MW unit, example given in the article

source.note: Wikipedia, Centrifugal pump, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

limitations: The Wikipedia page gives no efficiency or head ranges and says little about positive-displacement pumps
Only one historic manufacturer is named
